description: Evaluation question set for OnboardAI (ON-23). Thirty questions about the synthetic Larkfield Systems handbook in data/handbook. Twenty are answerable from the corpus and carry their expected answer and the section that answers it. Ten are unanswerable and must produce the HR fallback rather than an invented policy; each names the deliberate gap in the corpus it relies on.

questions.question: When did the Portland office open?
questions.supporting_text: second office in Portland, Oregon, which opened in 2019

questions.question: When does the fiscal year run?
questions.supporting_text: Our fiscal year runs from 1 February to 31 January.

questions.question: How long is the introductory period for a new employee?
questions.expected_answer: 90 calendar days from the start date.
questions.supporting_text: an introductory period of 90 calendar days

questions.question: What are the core hours?
questions.supporting_text: Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 Eastern Time.

questions.question: What is the monthly wellness stipend?

questions.question: How quickly must I disclose a conflict of interest?
questions.expected_answer: Within 10 business days of becoming aware of it.
questions.supporting_text: within 10 business days of becoming aware of it
